assess.description: Inventory a target project: build tool, JDKs, modules, root packages, quality plugins already present

measure.description: Run PMD with every threshold at 1 and print each metric's distribution and proposed knee

floors.description: Read each module's jacoco.xml and print the coverage floor: measured minus 2 points

falsify.description: Plant a violation for a named gate, run verify, expect red, revert
